sources: Hits, frames, keys and events: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0022_bounda_* and Json/BuffData buff_chr_0022_bounda_* (game 1.6), as compiled by efsim kit-draft and corrected by hand where the compiler lists alternatives as extra landings (open list D3): a projectile with castSkillOnHit and castSkillOnBlock naming one skill is one landing; the battle skill's explosion at entity frame 89 and the one at 149 are JumpToAction branches of one explosion. Frames are SkillData frames; projectile hits use the launch frame (travel isn't in the data, in-game test 47). Batch-2 report docs/kit-batches/batch-2/chr_0022_bounda.md (gap report, kit plan and the section "Kit").

Values: SkillPatchTable chr_0022_bounda_*; talents (PotentialTalentEffectTable): talent 1 attaches skill chr_0022_bounda_talent_1 (dmg_up 0.1 / 0.2), talent 2 attaches chr_0022_bounda_talent_2 (atk_up 0.1 / 0.2, probability 0.2, duration 10; P2 probability +0.1). P3 sets the battle skill's duration_potential (6) and potential_lv (3); P4 ultimate cost ×0.9 (data); P5 attaches buff_chr_0022_bounda_potential_5_auro (CD 1, reduce 1).

Log check: fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-abfd4b7478ec.json (Fluorite P5, skills level 1): attacks 1-4 one landing each, attack4 at atk_scale (not display_atk_scale), the combo one atk_scale hit followed by her Cryo burst (the infliction of the window's element), the ultimate four equal atk_scaleN hits and the 4th shot's Cryo branch. She never casts her battle skill there, so the explosive, talent 1 and the detonation are unverified by logs.

buffs.label: Improvised Explosive (stuck to the target)
buffs.note: State only: the ability entity abilityentity_chr_0022_bounda_normal_skill from its spawn (normal_skill_projhit, cast frame 10) to its explosion (entity frame 89, or at once when an ultimate shot's buff_chr_0022_bounda_ultimate_skill reaches the target: JumpToAction to 149). 3.1 s = the projhit's SlowAction literal, so it outlasts the explosion at cast frame 99. Whether a second kick replaces the first ("only 1 Improvised Explosive can be present") isn't in the data: here the second refreshes this marker and only one explosion follows (in-game test F3).

buffs.label: Love the Stab and Twist: DMG against Slowed targets
buffs.note: Talent 1: "Fluorite gains DMG Dealt +{dmg_up} against Slowed targets." buff_chr_0022_bounda_talent_1 (lifeType 1): damageModifier with CheckTagMatch 1925762097 (the Slow tag of buff_common_affixes_slow) on the target → NormalCalcZone + dmg_up. Any Slow counts, a teammate's too (the condition is the tag only; in-game test F2). No duration: the whole fight.

buffs.label: Unpredictable: ATK
buffs.note: Talent 2: on taking Arts DMG, a `probability` chance (0.2; P2 +0.1) of Arts DMG immunity (buff_common_damage_immune_talent, 0.01 s: damage taken isn't modelled) and ATK +atk_up (0.1 / 0.2) for `duration` (10 s; stackingType 4: refreshed). The chance is the trigger's (rolled; batch 2 K1).

triggers.note: CharGrowthTable: "COMBO TRIGGER: When an enemy has 2 or more stacks of Cryo Infliction or Nature Infliction."

The kick: LaunchProjectile at frame 10 (castSkillOnHit and castSkillOnBlock both → chr_0022_bounda_normal_skill_projhit: SpawnAbilityEntity abilityentity_chr_0022_bounda_normal_skill on the target + SlowAction, duration literal 3.1 s, rate move_speed_scalar). The skill's own effect: dropped if the cast is cut short before frame 10, and a rotation step without `at` waits for it (awaited).
The entity ends itself after exploding (FinishOwnerAction at entity frame 90 / 150).

hits.label: Detonated explosion
hits.note: Ultimate text: "If an Improvised Explosive has been stuck to the target, [it] detonates it immediately and increases the DMG and size of the explosion." Each ultimate projhit creates buff_chr_0022_bounda_ultimate_skill on the target; the entity's JumpToAction (frames 0–89, CheckBuffStackNum ≥ 1) jumps to 149: radius 4, DamageScaleProcessor ProdCalcZone +0.3 (the literal; boom_up is 0.3 at every level). A trigger hit, so Link isn't applied to it (in-game test F1).

triggers.note: The first ultimate shot that lands on a target with the explosive detonates it; the frame-99 explosion then finds no explosive and doesn't happen.

buff_chr_0022_bounda_talent_2: abilityEvent 101 (she takes damage) × 4 branches, CheckTagMatch on the attacker (an enemy), CheckDamageType 2 / 3 / 4 / 6 (Heat, Electric, Cryo, Nature: Arts DMG), Probablity `probability` → the immunity and the ATK buff. The enemy's attacks come from the scenario (enemyActions); the chance is rolled on the battle's `chance` stream.
Talent 1's buff is on from the start of the fight (lifeType 1).

P5: "Whenever Cryo Infliction or Nature Infliction is applied to the enemy, [combo] cooldown is shortened by {reduce}s. Effect can only trigger once every 1s." buff_chr_0022_bounda_potential_5_auro auras buff_chr_0022_bounda_potential_5_cd onto enemies: abilityEvent 121 + CheckSpellInflictionType mask 12 (Cryo, Nature) + her timed marker (CD 1 s) → SetSkillCdAtOnce combo −reduce. Whether an infliction that forms a reaction counts is open (in-game test 35).

skills.label: Basic attack 3

hits.note: attack3_projhit ObtainCostAction costType 1: atb × 0.333 (SimpleCalcBB), main character only; atb is 0 at every level.

skills.note: Its windows: attack4 in frames 18–24, attack4_1 in 24–30 (the chain step by timing).

hits.label: Final Strike
hits.note: One projectile (its hit and block routes are one landing). Final Strike (mask 2097280); `atb` SP (atbOnlyMainChar) and stagger `attack_poise` only as the controlled operator. display_atk_scale (3 × atk_scale) is the tooltip only: the log's attack4 hits are one atk_scale landing.

hits.label: Final Strike
hits.note: attack4 from an input in attack3's later window (24–30): the same projectile and values, launched at 26.

skills.label: Finisher
skills.note: BreakingAttackCalculation at frame 20, multiplier 1 (mask 132); the engine adds the finisher multiplier and SP and gates it on a Staggered enemy.

skills.label: Dive attack
skills.note: A rotation's dive: a jump, then this landing (batch-1 S10).

skills.label: Battle skill (Tiny Surprise)

dataOverride.applies@159: The entity's JumpToAction to 149 (the ultimate's marker on the target) is the other branch of the one explosion, not a second one (open list D3): the kit deals it from the trigger ultimate_detonates when an ultimate shot lands, and the frame-99 explosion then doesn't happen.
dataOverride.lands chr_0022_bounda_normal_skill_abili: The entity's JumpToAction to 149 (the ultimate's marker on the target) is the other branch of the one explosion, not a second one (open list D3): the kit deals it from the trigger ultimate_detonates when an ultimate shot lands, and the frame-99 explosion then doesn't happen.

hits.label: Explosion
hits.note: The explosive's explosion at entity frame 89 (cast frame 10 + 89): radius 3, Nature DMG atk_scale (mask 4352), Nature Infliction, stagger `poise`, InterruptAction 1 s (not Immobilization: no effect). Only while the explosive is still stuck (not detonated by the ultimate first). P3: "After Improvised Explosive explodes, the slow effect is applied to all enemies hit and lasts {duration_potential}s" (IfElse potential_lv ≥ 3; the key is 0 below P3).

skills.note: Team energy: the explosion's CreateBuff buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp (entity frame 89, cast frame 99; or at entity frame 149 when an ultimate shot detonates it, still given at 99 here). The entity outlives the cast, so the part is detached: a later skill or a jump doesn't drop it.

skills.label: Combo skill (Free Giveaway)

dataOverride.applies@15: SwitchAction on EntityBB_combo_index (2 → Cryo, 3 → Nature), set natively when the window opens: the window's element (`element: event`).

hits.note: "Applies another Arts Infliction of the element already on the enemy": SwitchAction on EntityBB_combo_index (2 → Cryo, 3 → Nature), set when the window opens, so the window's element (`event`). usp only with a target (ObtainCostAction in the DamageAction's succeedActions).

skills.note: The combo's EventListener → buff_chr_0022_bounda_potential_4 needs atk_up_potential_4 > 0, which nothing sets (P4 is the ultimate cost cut): left out, like the orphan combo_skill_projhit and the unused atk_scale_add keys.

skills.label: Ultimate (Apex Prankster)

hits.note: "If the final DMG sequence hits a target with at least 2 stacks of Cryo Infliction or Nature Infliction, then apply the same Arts Infliction again": IfElse CheckBuffStackNumAdvanced ≥ 2 Nature first, else ≥ 2 Cryo (an enemy holds one element's infliction at a time, so they don't overlap).

skills.note: Four projectiles launched at 59 / 63 / 67 / 72 (the log's gaps are longer: travel, in-game test 47); each puts buff_chr_0022_bounda_ultimate_skill (0.2 s) on the target, which detonates a stuck explosive (trigger ultimate_detonates). Time stop 0–56, cantCastSkill and cantSwitchPosition 0–77 and the damage immunity come from SkillData.
